name: dsh-dailyboard
description: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI: a one-month calendar with colored timeline bars, a daily checklist, week and day views with a draggable 24-hour timeline, weekly/interval recurring tasks with per-day result records, a long-term progress entry in the calendar header, a collapsible daily email reminder that can be pushed to WeChat and can remind other people (partners, relatives, …) with per-recipient notes and send times, and AI task extraction from natural language with smart date parsing (single-day tasks become day tasks, “this week/month” starts from today unless the work already happened) — press Enter to extract.
author: GinoXiang
